words.ex: Good actors can show strong emotions with just their eyes: joy, fear or sadness, without saying a word.
Rustam never talks about his feelings: he keeps his love, his fears and his worries to himself.
My mum is very emotional: she cries at the end of every sad film, even cartoons.
Our whole school was proud of Madina when she won a gold medal at the Asian Games.
My heart was full of pride when Uzbekistan qualified for the football World Cup for the first time.
I was disappointed with my IELTS result: I wanted a 7, but I only got a 6.
To the disappointment of all the fans, the concert in Tashkent was cancelled at the last minute.
The new bus map is so complicated that many tourists look confused when they try to read it.
Because Ali and Aliya sit next to each other and have similar names, there's always confusion when the teacher calls the register.
The doctors are hopeful that the young footballer will play again after his knee operation.
I was so curious to know what was inside the big box that I opened it before my birthday.
Out of curiosity, I pressed the red button in the lift, and an alarm rang through the whole building.
Mum always feels anxious until my brother texts her that his plane has landed safely in Istanbul.
Before her driving test, Gulnora's anxiety was so strong that she couldn't sleep all night.
My little sister is scared of dogs, so she crosses the street every time she sees one.
When the new baby arrived, five-year-old Timur felt jealous because everyone gave all their attention to his little brother.
Kamila was really upset when someone broke the screen of her new phone and didn't even say sorry.
Even on a cold Monday morning, our bus driver is always cheerful and says 'Good morning!' to every passenger with a big smile.
We spent the whole camping trip in a wet tent in the rain and felt cold and miserable.
After he lost his job, Farhod was depressed for months and didn't want to see anyone.
Don't ask Dad for money right now: he's in a bad mood because his car broke down this morning.
After a morning run, I feel energetic and ready to clean the whole flat.
The coach shouted in anger when the referee gave the other team a penalty.
My aunt is a nurse at a children's hospital in Fergana, where she cares for sick babies.
Too much homework and not enough sleep can cause stress in teenagers.
Kamron's jealousy grew every time his best friend got a better mark in the maths test than him.
The kitten was frightened by the thunder and hid under the sofa all night.
You could see the love in the young mother's eyes as she sang her baby to sleep.
